definition_en: to make something happen later than planned, or the time lost by waiting
core_image: 站台上的人群一起抬头看晚点的牌子
scene: 大雪压住了铁轨，清晨的列车一班接一班停在站外。Heavy snow delayed the morning trains.
sceneCN: 这里 delay 指「耽搁」（第 1 个义项：使事情比计划更晚发生）；句意是大雪让早班列车晚点。

senses.title: Make it happen later
senses.definition: to arrange for something to take place at a later time
senses.definitionCN: 把某事安排到更晚的时间进行
senses.example: They delayed the meeting until Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把会议推迟到星期五。
senses.why: A thing put off is a thing still waiting on the shelf.
senses.whyCN: 被推迟的事，就是还搁在架子上等着的。

senses.title: Hold someone up on the way
senses.definition: to make a person or vehicle late by slowing them down
senses.definitionCN: 因拖慢速度而使人或车辆迟到
senses.example: Heavy snow delayed the morning trains.
senses.exampleCN: 大雪让早班列车晚点。
senses.why: One slow point on a road makes every traveller late.
senses.whyCN: 路上一个慢下来的地方，就让所有赶路的人迟到。

senses.title: The time lost in waiting
senses.definition: the period of waiting caused by something being late
senses.definitionCN: 因某事迟到而产生的等待时间
senses.example: There was a delay of two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 延误了两个小时。
senses.why: Waiting is the shape that lost time takes in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 等待，就是失去的时间在心里留下的形状。

intro.en: Delay comes from Old French delaier, to put off, built on Latin laxare, to loosen.
intro.cn: delay 来自古法语 delaier（往后放），底层是拉丁语 laxare（放松、松开）。

items.en: Laxare meant to loosen a hold or a rope.
items.cn: laxare 意为把抓住的手或绳子松开。

items.en: Delaier joined de- with laier, to leave something for later.
items.cn: delaier 由 de- 与 laier 合成，意为留到以后再说。

items.en: English used delay for both putting off and being held up.
items.cn: 英语用它既指主动推迟，也指被动耽搁。

items.en: The noun delay settled into talk of journeys and courts.
items.cn: 名词用法在旅途与法庭的说法里安定下来。

items.en: Trains, flights and replies are all said to be delayed.
items.cn: 如今列车、航班和回复都可以说被延误。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -ay ending, and the meaning group names three ways of making something wait.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -ay 这个尾巴，近义组则是三种让人或事等一等的方式。

entries.definition: to pass a message or signal on
to be slowly destroyed by natural causes
to make a fear or worry less strong
to move an event to a later date
entries.definitionCN: 把活动改到更晚的日期

entries.definition: to decide to do something later
to stop something from moving on time

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a crowd looking up at a board and end with two hours that simply vanished.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一群人抬头看牌子开始，落到凭空消失的两个小时。

normal.en: A train is late once, but the waiting is repeated by everyone.
normal.cn: 列车只晚一次，等待却被每个人各经历一遍。

normal.en: Delay is not a stop; the wheels are still turning, only slower.
normal.cn: 耽搁不是停下，轮子还在转，只是慢了。

normal.en: The meeting moved by two days costs two days of guessing.
normal.cn: 会议挪两天，就多出两天猜测。

normal.en: To delay a reply is to say nothing in a loud way.
normal.cn: 拖着不回，就是用很响的方式什么也不说。

normal.en: Relay passes a message on; delay keeps it back.
normal.cn: relay 把消息传下去，delay 把消息留住。

abstract.en: Picture a clock with one hand moving slower than the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟，一根针走得比另一根慢。

abstract.en: Picture a queue that does not move but grows.
abstract.cn: 想象一支不往前挪、却越来越长的队伍。

abstract.en: Picture a letter left in a drawer for a week.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信在抽屉里躺了一星期。

examples.en: Heavy snow delayed the morning trains.
examples.cn: 大雪让早班列车晚点。

examples.en: They delayed the meeting until Friday.
examples.cn: 他们把会议推迟到星期五。

examples.en: There was a delay of two hours.
examples.cn: 延误了两个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 delay 记成「地雷」：路上踩到地雷，队伍就走不动，只好延误。

root: 来自古法语 delaier（留到以后），其底层是拉丁语 laxare（松开），本义是把抓着的事放开、让它往后滑。它先指主动推迟，后来也指被动耽搁，如今连列车、航班与回复晚到都用它。

sensesIntro.en: From a plan moved forward on the calendar, to a train held in the snow, to the empty hours that remain.
sensesIntro.cn: 从日历上往后挪的计划，到被雪挡住的列车，再到剩下那几个空掉的小时。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a station board where one line turns late.
core.cn: 核心意象：车站牌上有一行变成了晚点。

branches.en: The first sense moves the agreed time further on.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把商定的时间往后挪。

branches.en: The second sense is being slowed on the way.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是在路上被拖慢。

branches.en: The third sense is the waiting that results.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是由此产生的等待。

branches.en: A choice and an accident produce the same lateness.
branches.cn: 主动的选择与被动的意外，造成同一种晚。

branches.en: The train and the empty hour are one event seen twice.
branches.cn: 晚点的列车与空掉的一小时，是同一件事的两面。

intro.en: Delay forms a few adjectives and nouns, all about lateness and waiting.
intro.cn: delay 能派生出几个形容词与名词，全都与晚点和等待有关。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is laxare, to loosen, with de- giving the sense of away.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 laxare（松开），前缀 de- 带来「离开」的意味。

items.meaning: to put off, or the wait
items.example: The delay was caused by fog.
The delayed train arrived at noon.
A delaying tactic bought them a day.
items.exampleCN: 拖延的办法为他们争到一天。

items.example: He was the delayer of every plan.
items.exampleCN: 每个计划都是他拖下来的。

items.example: A long delay tested our patience.
items.exampleCN: 漫长的延误考验了我们的耐性。

items.meaning: a gap between act and result
items.example: There is a short time delay in the signal.

definition_en: on purpose, or in a slow and calm way
core_image: 一只手慢慢伸出去，明知会碰倒仍不收回
scene: 他把最后一道题空着交上去，走出考场时脚步很稳。He deliberately left the last question unanswered.
sceneCN: 这里 deliberately 指「故意地」（第 1 个义项：有意识地这么做）；句意是他故意把最后一题留空。

senses.title: With full intention
senses.definition: with the full knowledge that one is doing it
senses.definitionCN: 完全知道自己正在这么做
senses.example: He deliberately left the last question unanswered.
senses.exampleCN: 他故意把最后一题留空。
senses.why: A hand that does not shake shows the mind has already decided.
senses.whyCN: 手不发抖，说明心里早就定了。

senses.title: Without any hurry
senses.definition: in a slow, steady and calm manner
senses.definitionCN: 以缓慢、平稳而镇定的方式
senses.example: She closed the book deliberately and stood up.
senses.exampleCN: 她不慌不忙地合上书，站起身来。
senses.why: Slowness can be a form of control, not a lack of it.
senses.whyCN: 慢也可以是一种掌控，而不是失控。

intro.en: Deliberately is deliberate plus -ly, and deliberate goes back to Latin libra, a balance.
intro.cn: deliberately 是 deliberate 加 -ly，而 deliberate 上溯到拉丁语的 libra（天平）。

items.en: Libra was the scale used to weigh goods.
items.cn: libra 是称货用的天平。

items.en: Deliberare meant to weigh a matter before acting.
items.cn: deliberare 意为行动前先把事情称一称。

items.en: English kept the picture of a slow and careful mind.
items.cn: 英语保留了那种缓慢而小心的画面。

items.en: The adverb marked acts that were clearly intended.
items.cn: 副词形式用来标示明显有意的行为。

items.en: Today it can accuse and admire in the same breath.
items.cn: 如今它既可用于指责，也可用于赞赏。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the deliberate stem, and the meaning group offers three ways to say it was no accident.
note.cn: 形近组共用 deliberate 这个词干，近义组则给出三种「不是意外」的说法。

entries.definition: done on purpose and after thought
long and careful discussion
in a gentle and careful way
with the purpose of doing it
for a set reason, not by chance
entries.definitionCN: 出于既定理由，而非偶然

entries.definition: while fully aware of what one does
entries.definitionCN: 完全清楚自己在做什么

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a blank answer on a test paper and end with a hand that closes a book slowly.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从考卷上一处空白开始，落到一只慢慢合上书的手。

normal.en: A blank left on purpose is still an answer.
normal.cn: 有意留出的空白，也是一种回答。

normal.en: The steadiest hand in the room has already decided.
normal.cn: 屋里最稳的那只手，早就做好了决定。

normal.en: To be vague on purpose is to hide behind fog you made.
normal.cn: 故意含糊，就是躲进自己造的雾里。

normal.en: Slow steps are not weak steps.
normal.cn: 慢的脚步，不是弱的脚步。

normal.en: Deliberate plus -ly turns a weighing mind into a manner.
normal.cn: deliberate 加 -ly，称量的心思就变成了举止。

abstract.en: Picture a pen lifted just before it touches the paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔在碰到纸之前停住。

abstract.en: Picture a door held open for no one in particular.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门被扶着，谁也没在过。

abstract.en: Picture two eyes meeting yours and not looking away.
abstract.cn: 想象一双眼睛对上你的，没有躲开。

examples.en: He deliberately left the last question unanswered.
examples.cn: 他故意把最后一题留空。

examples.en: She closed the book deliberately and stood up.
examples.cn: 她不慌不忙地合上书，站起身来。

examples.en: The report was deliberately vague about the date.
examples.cn: 报告在日期上故意写得含糊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 deliberately 记成「地里有谱」：心里早有谱，才做得不慌不忙，也都是故意为之。

root: 由 deliberate 加副词词尾 -ly 构成。deliberate 出自拉丁语 deliberare，词根 libra 是天平，本义是称量、权衡。称过的举动是有意的，称的过程是缓慢的，所以这个词同时表示「故意地」与「从容地」。

sensesIntro.en: From an act nobody can call accidental, to a pace nobody can call hurried.
sensesIntro.cn: 从没人能说是意外的举动，到没人能说是匆忙的步调。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady hand that does not stop itself.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只稳稳伸出、并不收回的手。

branches.en: The first sense removes any excuse of accident.
branches.cn: 第一个义项排除了「不小心」这个借口。

branches.en: The second sense is the same control shown in speed.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是同样的掌控体现在速度上。

branches.en: Both senses come from a mind that has already weighed the matter.
branches.cn: 两个义项都出自一颗已经称量过的心。

branches.en: Deliberately in a charge sheet means the act was chosen.
branches.cn: 在指控里说故意，意思是这行为是选出来的。

branches.en: In praise, deliberately means nothing was rushed or wasted.
branches.cn: 在称赞里，它意味着没有一样东西被赶出来或浪费掉。

intro.en: Deliberately sits at the adverb end of the deliberate family, next to deliberation and deliberative.
intro.cn: deliberately 站在 deliberate 这一族的副词一端，旁边是 deliberation 与 deliberative。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is libra, a balance, with de- meaning thoroughly.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 libra（天平），前缀 de- 表示彻底。

items.example: He deliberately took the longer road.
items.exampleCN: 他故意走了更远的那条路。

items.example: They met in a deliberative mood.
items.exampleCN: 他们带着审议的心情开会。

items.example: The deliberateness of the silence was plain.
items.exampleCN: 那片沉默显然是有意的。
那封信被故意搁着不理。

definition_en: to take goods or letters to a place; to give a speech; to do what was promised
core_image: 一双手把包裹递到门口，收件人签下名字
scene: 快递员在午前按响门铃，把纸箱放在门垫上。The driver delivered the parcel before noon.
sceneCN: 这里 deliver 指「递送」（第 1 个义项：把物品送到某处）；句意是司机在中午前把包裹送到了。

senses.title: Take something to its place
senses.definition: to carry goods, letters or food to the person or place waiting for them
senses.definitionCN: 把货物、信件或食物送到等待的人或地点
senses.example: The driver delivered the parcel before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 司机在中午前把包裹送到了。
senses.why: A thing only counts as sent when it has arrived.
senses.whyCN: 东西只有到了，才算真的寄出去。

senses.title: Give a speech aloud
senses.definition: to speak words to an audience in a formal setting
senses.definitionCN: 在正式场合向听众讲出一段话
senses.example: She delivered a short speech at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 她在门口作了一个简短的讲话。
senses.why: Words too are carried from one mouth to many ears.
senses.whyCN: 话也是被从一个嘴里送到许多只耳朵里的。

senses.title: Do what was promised
senses.definition: to produce the result that was promised or expected
senses.definitionCN: 交出所承诺或所期待的结果
senses.example: The new team delivered results in the first month.
senses.exampleCN: 新团队在第一个月就交出了成果。
senses.why: A promise is only a parcel that has not arrived yet.
senses.whyCN: 承诺不过是一个还没送到的包裹。

intro.en: Deliver comes from Old French delivrer, from Latin de- and liberare, to set free.
intro.cn: deliver 来自古法语 delivrer，底层是拉丁语的 de- 与 liberare（使自由）。

items.en: Liberare meant to set a person free.
items.cn: liberare 意为把人释放、使之自由。

items.en: Delivrer added the sense of handing something over.
items.cn: delivrer 又添上「把东西交出去」的意思。

items.en: English used deliver for freeing and for giving up a thing.
items.cn: 英语用它既表示解救，也表示交出东西。

items.en: The sense of carrying goods to a place grew strong.
items.cn: 把货物送到某地的意思渐渐占了上风。

items.en: One can now deliver a parcel, a speech or a result.
items.cn: 如今可以送包裹、作演讲，也可以交出成果。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the liver stem, and the meaning group moves from handing over to sending.
note.cn: 形近组共用 liver 这个词干，近义组则从交给一路走到送出。

entries.definition: the act of being set free
a result that must be handed over
to live through something again in memory
entries.definitionCN: 在记忆里重新经历某事

entries.definition: to give something into another's hands
to cause something to go to a place
to offer something formally to others
entries.definitionCN: 正式地向他人呈交某物

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a bell at the door and end with a promise that finally turns into a result.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从门口的一声铃开始，落到一个终于变成结果的承诺。

normal.en: A parcel in the van is still only a plan.
normal.cn: 车里的包裹，还只是一个计划。

normal.en: The last step of any journey is a pair of hands.
normal.cn: 任何一段路，最后一步都是一双手。

normal.en: A speech is carried across the room by breath.
normal.cn: 演讲是靠一口气送到屋子对面的。

normal.en: Results are promises that have arrived.
normal.cn: 成果，就是已经送到的承诺。

normal.en: Deliver once meant to set free; now it means to hand over.
normal.cn: deliver 曾表示「使自由」，如今表示「交到手里」。

abstract.en: Picture a box set down on a mat and a pen offered.
abstract.cn: 想象一个箱子放在门垫上，旁边递来一支笔。

abstract.en: Picture one voice going out and many faces lifting.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音出去，许多张脸抬起来。

abstract.en: Picture a signed paper slid across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张签好的纸从桌面上推过来。

examples.en: The driver delivered the parcel before noon.
examples.cn: 司机在中午前把包裹送到了。

examples.en: She delivered a short speech at the door.
examples.cn: 她在门口作了一个简短的讲话。

examples.en: The new team delivered results in the first month.
examples.cn: 新团队在第一个月就交出了成果。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 deliver 记成「递礼物」：de 开头，liver 听着像「礼物」，把礼物递到手上，就是送达。

root: 来自古法语 delivrer，底层是拉丁语 liberare（使自由），所以它最早表示「解救、释放」。后来「把东西放出去」变成「把东西交出去」，十五世纪起「送到某地」成为主要意思，又引申出发表演讲与兑现成果。

sensesIntro.en: From a parcel at the door, to words crossing a room, to a promise turned into fact.
sensesIntro.cn: 从门口的包裹，到穿过屋子的话，再到变成事实的承诺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands passing a parcel into other hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：一双手把包裹交到另一双手里。

branches.en: The first sense is a parcel arriving where it was sent.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是包裹到达它被寄去的地方。

branches.en: The second sense carries words instead of goods.
branches.cn: 第二个义项送的是话，不是货。

branches.en: The third sense carries a result that was owed.
branches.cn: 第三个义项送的是欠着的成果。

branches.en: A parcel and a promise both count only when they arrive.
branches.cn: 包裹与承诺，都要到了才算数。

branches.en: Both senses turn something held back into something handed over.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把攥着的东西变成交出去的东西。

intro.en: Deliver has a family of nouns for the act and the person, and an adjective for what never arrived.
intro.cn: deliver 有表示行为与人的名词，也有表示没送到的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is liberare, to free, with de- meaning away.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 liberare（使自由），前缀 de- 表示离开。

items.meaning: to carry to a place, or to hand over

items.example: The deliverer left the box at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 送货人把箱子放在门口。

items.meaning: a result to be handed over
items.exampleCN: 每个阶段都有一项应交付的成果。
那封信没送到，被退了回来。

items.example: He delivered a speech on peace.
items.exampleCN: 他发表了关于和平的演讲。

items.example: The plan must deliver results soon.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划必须尽快交出成果。

definition_en: the act of bringing goods or letters; the way words are spoken; the birth of a baby
core_image: 门口的纸箱上贴着一张写着他名字的条子
scene: 巷口的小店在玻璃上贴了一张纸，说是本城范围内不收运费。The shop offers free delivery within the city.
sceneCN: 这里 delivery 指「投递」（第 1 个义项：把货物送到顾客手中）；句意是这家店在本城范围内免运费送货。

pos.zh: 投递；交付；演讲方式；分娩

senses.title: The bringing of goods
senses.definition: the act of taking goods, letters or food to a customer
senses.definitionCN: 把货物、信件或食物送到顾客手中的行为
senses.example: The shop offers free delivery within the city.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店在本城范围内免运费送货。
senses.why: The last metre of a journey is the one the buyer pays for.
senses.whyCN: 一段路的最后一米，才是买家真正花钱买的那段。

senses.title: The way words are spoken
senses.definition: the manner in which a speech or song is given to listeners
senses.definitionCN: 把讲话或歌曲呈现给听众的方式
senses.example: Her delivery was calm and clear.
senses.exampleCN: 她的表达从容而清楚。
senses.why: The same sentence can be handed over gently or dropped.
senses.whyCN: 同一句话，可以轻轻递过去，也可以扔过去。

senses.title: The birth of a child
senses.definition: the act of a baby coming out of its mother's body
senses.definitionCN: 婴儿从母亲身体里出来的过程
senses.example: The delivery went well and both were healthy.
senses.exampleCN: 分娩顺利，母子都健康。
senses.why: A new life also has to be carried out into the air.
senses.whyCN: 新的生命，也要被送到空气里来。

intro.en: Delivery is deliver plus -y, and deliver goes back to Latin liberare, to set free.
intro.cn: delivery 是 deliver 加 -y，而 deliver 上溯到拉丁语 liberare（使自由）。

items.en: Liberare meant to release a person from a hold.
items.cn: liberare 意为把一个人从束缚中放开。

items.en: Delivrer meant to hand over or to set free.
items.cn: delivrer 意为交出，也意为释放。

items.en: The noun delivery named both rescue and handing over.
items.cn: 名词 delivery 同时指解救与交出。

items.en: Trade gave it the everyday sense of goods arriving.
items.cn: 商业给了它「货物送达」这个日常意思。

items.en: It now also covers the manner of speaking and the birth of a child.
items.cn: 如今它也指说话的方式与婴儿的出生。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the liver shape, and the meaning group names what arrives at a door.
note.cn: 形近组共用 liver 这个形状，近义组则指送到门口的那批东西。

entries.definition: to bring goods to a place
the uniform worn by servants
the state of being set free
a load of goods sent together
goods sent to someone to be sold
the act of passing something to another
entries.definitionCN: 把东西交给另一方的行为

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a name on a box and end with a sentence handed gently to a hall.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从箱子上贴着的名字开始，落到一句被轻轻递到大厅里的话。

normal.en: The box knows your name before you do.
normal.cn: 箱子先知道你的名字，你才知道它到了。

normal.en: Good delivery is quiet: no dropped corners, no broken eggs.
normal.cn: 好的送货很安静：不摔角，不碎蛋。

normal.en: The same line, delivered slowly, becomes a different line.
normal.cn: 同一句话，慢慢递出去，就成了另一句话。

normal.en: A promise and a parcel both end at a door.
normal.cn: 承诺与包裹，最后都停在一扇门前。

normal.en: Delivery is the noun that deliver leaves behind.
normal.cn: delivery 就是 deliver 留下的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a strip of tape being pressed down on a box.
abstract.cn: 想象一条胶带被按在纸箱上。

abstract.en: Picture a signature made quickly with a borrowed pen.
abstract.cn: 想象用借来的笔匆匆签下一个名字。

abstract.en: Picture a room going quiet so a voice can be heard.
abstract.cn: 想象一屋子人安静下来，好让一个声音被听见。

examples.en: The shop offers free delivery within the city.
examples.cn: 这家店在本城范围内免运费送货。

examples.en: Her delivery was calm and clear.
examples.cn: 她的表达从容而清楚。

examples.en: The delivery went well and both were healthy.
examples.cn: 分娩顺利，母子都健康。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 delivery 记成「递礼物」：把礼物递到门口，就是投递；递话递得好，就是表达。

root: 由 deliver 加名词词尾 -y 构成。deliver 出自拉丁语 liberare（使自由）与古法语 delivrer，先指解救与交出，后来「把货物送到」成为日常意思，又引申出说话的表达方式与婴儿的分娩。

sensesIntro.en: From a box at the door, to a voice in a hall, to a new life carried into the air.
sensesIntro.cn: 从门口的箱子，到大厅里的声音，再到被送到空气里的新生命。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a box set down, with a name written on it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个箱子放下，上面写着名字。

branches.en: The first sense ends with goods in the buyer's hands.
branches.cn: 第一个义项以货物到买家手中结束。

branches.en: The second sense hands words to listeners instead.
branches.cn: 第二个义项递出去的是话，给的是听众。

branches.en: The third sense is a body arriving into the world.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是一个身体来到世上。

branches.en: Goods and words are both judged by how they arrive.
branches.cn: 货物与话，都要看它们是怎么到的。

branches.en: Both senses need care at the moment of handing over.
branches.cn: 两个义项在交出的那一刻都需要小心。

intro.en: Delivery sits at the noun end of a family that includes deliver, deliverer and deliverable.
intro.cn: delivery 站在这一族的名词一端，同族还有 deliver、deliverer、deliverable。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is liberare, to free, with de- meaning away.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 liberare（使自由），前缀 de- 表示离开。

items.meaning: the act of bringing or handing over

items.example: They deliver at six in the morning.

items.meaning: a result to be handed in
items.example: The first deliverable is due in May.
Free delivery applies over ten pounds.
The delivery date was moved forward.

items.meaning: the room where babies are born
items.example: He waited outside the delivery room.

definition_en: to ask for something firmly, or the need that people have for a thing
core_image: 一只手伸到柜台前，掌心向上，等着对方把东西递过来
scene: 柜台前排队的人越来越多，店员却只有两个，队伍里开始有人提高声音。The workers demanded a clear answer about their pay.
sceneCN: 这里 demand 指「要求」（第 1 个义项：坚决地提出要求）；句意是工人们要求就工资给出明确答复。

senses.title: Ask for something firmly
senses.definition: to ask for something in a strong way that expects an answer
senses.definitionCN: 以强硬、期待答复的方式提出要求
senses.example: The workers demanded a clear answer about their pay.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们要求就工资给出明确答复。
senses.why: A request becomes a demand when the asker will not take silence for an answer.
senses.whyCN: 当提问者不肯把沉默当作答复时，请求就变成了要求。

senses.title: The need for a product
senses.definition: the amount of a product or service that people want to buy
senses.definitionCN: 人们想购买的产品或服务的数量
senses.example: There is a growing demand for small electric cars.
senses.exampleCN: 小型电动汽车的需求在增长。
senses.why: Want becomes demand when it is strong enough to reach the market.
senses.whyCN: 当想要的力度大到愿意掏钱，想要就成了需求。

senses.title: Need time or effort
senses.definition: to need a particular quality, time or effort in order to be done
senses.definitionCN: 完成某事需要某种品质、时间或精力
senses.example: Learning a language demands patience.
senses.exampleCN: 学一门语言需要耐心。
senses.why: Some tasks ask for qualities the way people ask for help.
senses.whyCN: 有些任务索要品质，就像人开口求助一样。

intro.en: Demand reached English through Old French, but its parts are Latin: de- meaning fully and mandare meaning to hand over or order.
intro.cn: demand 经古法语进入英语，零件却是拉丁的：de- 表示完全，mandare 表示交付或命令。

items.en: Demandare joined de-, meaning fully, to mandare, to hand over or order.
items.cn: demandare 由 de-（完全）与 mandare（交付、命令）合成。

items.en: Demander could ask a question or make a claim in court.
items.cn: demander 既可以提问，也可以在法庭上提出主张。

items.en: English borrowed it as both a verb of asking and a noun of claim.
items.cn: 英语把它借来，既作表示询问的动词，也作表示主张的名词。

items.en: Economists gave the noun its sense of want backed by money.
items.cn: 经济学家给这个名词添上了「有购买力的想要」这一层。

items.en: Today it covers both a firm request and the pull of the market.
items.cn: 如今它既指坚决的请求，也指市场的拉动。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -mand sound, and the meaning group moves from a polite request to a legal claim.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -mand 这一段音，近义组则从礼貌请求一路走到法律上的主张。

entries.definition: to order someone to do something
needing a lot of time and effort
entries.definitionCN: 需要大量时间与精力的

entries.definition: a person who asks for something
to ask for something in a polite way
to need something or make it necessary
entries.definitionCN: 需要某物或使其成为必要

entries.definition: to say that something belongs to you

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a hand held out at a counter and end with a market that keeps pulling.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从柜台前伸出的一只手开始，落到一个不停拉动的市场。

normal.en: A hand held out and not pulled back is already a demand.
normal.cn: 一只手伸出去不收回，就已经是要求了。

normal.en: In a shop, want becomes demand when the money is ready.
normal.cn: 在店里，钱准备好了，想要就变成了需求。

normal.en: A task can demand patience the way a customer demands service.
normal.cn: 任务索要耐心，就像顾客索要服务。

normal.en: Two curves meet on a chart: one asks, one answers.
normal.cn: 两条曲线在图上相遇：一条发问，一条回答。

normal.en: Demand and command share a spine; one asks, one orders.
normal.cn: demand 与 command 共用一副骨架：一个请求，一个命令。

abstract.en: Picture a queue that grows longer while the counter stays the same.
abstract.cn: 想象队伍越来越长，柜台却始终只有那么大。

abstract.en: Picture an empty shelf with a note saying sold out.
abstract.cn: 想象一排空货架，上面贴着售罄的纸条。

abstract.en: Picture a palm turned upward and fingers closing slowly.
abstract.cn: 想象一只掌心向上的手，手指慢慢收拢。

examples.en: The workers demanded a clear answer about their pay.
examples.cn: 工人们要求就工资给出明确答复。

examples.en: There is a growing demand for small electric cars.
examples.cn: 小型电动汽车的需求在增长。

examples.en: Learning a language demands patience and daily practice.
examples.cn: 学一门语言需要耐心和每日练习。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 demand 记成「得忙的」：de 像「得」，mand 像「忙的」，订单一来，全厂都得忙起来，这就是要求与需求。

root: 来自拉丁语 demandare，由 de-（完全）与 mandare（交付、命令）组成，经古法语 demander 进入英语。它先是郑重地提出要求，后来又分出经济上的需求，也用来表示事情对时间与精力的索求。

sensesIntro.en: From a firm request at a counter, to the pull of the market, to the effort a task asks of you.
sensesIntro.cn: 从柜台前一句坚决的请求，到市场的拉动，再到任务向你要的时间与力气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a palm held out and waiting at a counter.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只掌心向上的手在柜台前等着。

branches.en: The first sense is a request that expects an answer.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是期待答复的请求。

branches.en: When many people want the same thing, the wish becomes a market force.
branches.cn: 当许多人都想要同一样东西，愿望就成了市场力量。

branches.en: A task can also ask, and what it asks for is time or patience.
branches.cn: 任务也会开口，它要的是时间或耐心。

branches.en: A firm request and a market need both push against the world.
branches.cn: 坚决的请求与市场的需要，都在向世界施压。

branches.en: Both the market and a hard task measure how much people will give.
branches.cn: 市场与艰难的任务都在衡量人愿意付出多少。

intro.en: Demand forms a small family around asking, needing and the side of the market that wants goods.
intro.cn: demand 长出一小族词，围绕请求、需要以及市场中想要货物的一方。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is mandare, to hand over or order, with de- adding fullness.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 mandare（交付、命令），前缀 de- 加上了完全的意思。

items.meaning: to ask firmly, or a need

items.exampleCN: 那是一份要求很高的工作。
提出要求的人在外面等。

items.meaning: relating to buyers in a market
items.exampleCN: 他们研究了需求侧的影响。

items.meaning: a line showing how much people will buy

items.exampleCN: 她是一位抢手的设计师。

items.meaning: in a way that asks for much

definition_zh: 民主；民主制度；民主国家
definition_en: a system in which people choose their leaders and share the power to decide
core_image: 广场上无数只手同时举起，每只手都握着同样一张票
scene: 投票站门口排起长队，老人拄着拐杖也要自己走进去投一票。A democracy depends on people who are willing to show up.
sceneCN: 这里 democracy 指「民主制度」（第 1 个义项：由人民选择领导者并分享决定权的制度）；句意是民主制度依靠那些愿意站出来的人。

pos.zh: 民主；民主制度；民主国家

senses.title: Rule by the people
senses.definition: a system of government in which adults choose their leaders by voting
senses.definitionCN: 成年人通过投票选择领导者的政治制度
senses.example: The country chose democracy after years of struggle.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家经过多年斗争选择了民主制度。
senses.why: Power is lent by many hands and can be taken back by the same hands.
senses.whyCN: 权力由许多只手借出，也能被同样多的手收回。

senses.title: A country run that way
senses.definition: a country whose government is chosen in free elections
senses.definitionCN: 通过自由选举产生政府的国家
senses.example: New democracies often rewrite their rules in the first years.
senses.exampleCN: 新的民主国家常在最初几年改写自己的规则。
senses.why: A place that lives by a system ends up wearing its name.
senses.whyCN: 按一种制度生活的地方，最后也会戴上它的名字。

senses.title: Fair voice in daily life
senses.definition: the habit of giving every person an equal say
senses.definitionCN: 让每个人都拥有同等发言权的习惯
senses.example: She brought a little democracy into the family meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 她给家庭会议带来了一点民主精神。
senses.why: The word leaves the ballot box and enters any room where voices are counted.
senses.whyCN: 这个词走出投票箱，进入任何需要数人头的房间。

intro.en: Democracy comes from Greek demos, the people, and kratia, rule; French carried it into English.
intro.cn: democracy 来自希腊语 demos（人民）与 kratia（统治），经法语进入英语。

items.en: Demos named the common people, and kratia named rule or strength.
items.cn: demos 指普通民众，kratia 指统治或力量。

items.en: Athens called its assembly-run city a demokratia.
items.cn: 雅典把由公民大会治理的城邦称为 demokratia。

items.en: Roman writers discussed the Greek idea but ruled through a republic.
items.cn: 罗马作家讨论过这个希腊观念，却以共和制来统治。

items.en: English borrowed democracy to name rule by the many.
items.cn: 英语借来 democracy，用来指多数人的统治。

items.en: It now also means a fair voice in schools, clubs and homes.
items.cn: 如今它也指学校、社团与家庭中的平等发言权。

note.en: The look-alike group all begin with demo-, and the meaning group turns from a form of state to the simple idea of equal voice.
note.cn: 形近组都以 demo- 开头，近义组则从国家形式转到平等发言这个朴素观念。

entries.definition: a person who believes in rule by the people
based on equal power for all people
entries.definitionCN: 建立在人人平等权力之上的

entries.definition: the study of populations
a state with an elected head, not a king
entries.definitionCN: 元首由选举产生而非君主的国家

entries.definition: the right of a group to rule itself
the state of being treated the same

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a raised hand in a square and end with a vote that can be taken back.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从广场上举起的一只手开始，落到一张可以被收回的选票。

normal.en: One person, one paper slip: the whole idea fits in a palm.
normal.cn: 一人一张纸，整套道理就握在掌心里。

normal.en: A ruler who fears the count will try to stop the counting.
normal.cn: 害怕数人头的统治者，总会想办法阻止清点。

normal.en: Democracy is loud on voting day and quiet in between.
normal.cn: 民主在投票日很响，在平常日子很静。

normal.en: The word is Greek, but the queue at the polling station is local.
normal.cn: 这个词是希腊的，投票站前的队伍却是本地的。

normal.en: A club, a class, a family: any room can hold a small democracy.
normal.cn: 社团、班级、家庭，任何一间屋子都能装下小小的民主。

abstract.en: Picture a square full of hands lifted at the same height.
abstract.cn: 想象一个广场，无数只手举到同样的高度。

abstract.en: Picture a box sealed, then opened, then counted in public.
abstract.cn: 想象一只箱子被封上、打开，再当众清点。

abstract.en: Picture a chair left empty because the voters chose someone else.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子空着，因为选民选了别人。

examples.en: The country chose democracy after years of struggle.
examples.cn: 这个国家经过多年斗争选择了民主制度。

examples.en: New democracies often rewrite their rules in the first years.
examples.cn: 新的民主国家常在最初几年改写自己的规则。

examples.en: A healthy democracy needs more than one loud voice.
examples.cn: 健康的民主制度需要不止一个响亮的声音。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 democracy 记成「得莫克拉西」：demos 是人民，kratia 是统治，人民来统治，就是民主。

root: 来自希腊语 demokratia，由 demos（人民）与 kratia（统治）组成，经法语进入英语。本义是由人民来统治，后来既指制度，也指实行这种制度的国家，又引申为日常生活中的平等精神。

sensesIntro.en: From many hands choosing a leader, to the country they build, to the small fairness of an ordinary room.
sensesIntro.cn: 从许多只手选出领导者，到他们建起的国家，再到普通房间里的一点公平。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a square full of raised hands, one vote in each.
core.cn: 核心意象：广场上举起一片手，每只手里一张票。

branches.en: The first sense is the machine: votes choose the people who decide.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那台机器：选票决定由谁来作决定。

branches.en: The second sense is the country that runs on that machine.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是靠这台机器运转的国家。

branches.en: The third sense is the habit, carried into small rooms.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是被带进小房间里的那种习惯。

branches.en: A system and a state share one name because the state is the system at work.
branches.cn: 制度与国家共用一个名字，因为国家就是运转中的制度。

branches.en: A country and a club both need the same small courtesy: let others speak.
branches.cn: 国家和社团都需要同一种小小的礼貌：让别人说话。

intro.en: Democracy has a Greek skeleton and grows words for believers, changes and the study of populations.
intro.cn: democracy 有一副希腊骨架，长出了表示信奉者、变革与人口研究的词。

latinIntro.en: The Greek pieces are demos, the people, and kratia, rule; Latin kept the idea rather than the word.
latinIntro.cn: 它的希腊零件是 demos（人民）与 kratia（统治）；拉丁语留下的是观念，不是这个词。

items.exampleCN: 民主制度需要耐心的公民。

items.meaning: a believer in rule by the people
items.exampleCN: 她一生都是民主主义者。

items.meaning: based on equal power for all
in a fair and equal way
items.exampleCN: 领导者是以民主方式选出的。

items.meaning: to make something open to all

definition_zh: 民主的；有民主精神的；平等的
definition_en: based on the idea that all people have an equal right to choose and to speak
core_image: 一间教室里所有人围坐成一圈，谁都可以举手说话
scene: 班会上老师没有直接定下方案，而是让每个同学先说自己想法。The club made a democratic decision to share the work equally.
sceneCN: 这里 democratic 指「民主的」（第 1 个义项：由众人平等参与决定的）；句意是这个社团以民主方式决定平分工作。

pos.zh: 民主的；有民主精神的；平等的

senses.title: Run by the people
senses.definition: of a system in which people vote and share power
senses.definitionCN: 属于由人民投票并分享权力的制度的
senses.example: The country held its first democratic election in decades.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家举行了几十年来第一次民主选举。
senses.why: A system is democratic when power starts at the bottom and moves up.
senses.whyCN: 权力从下面长上去的制度，才叫民主的。

senses.title: Fair to every member
senses.definition: treating every member as having an equal say
senses.definitionCN: 让每个成员都拥有同等发言权的
senses.example: The club made a democratic decision to share the work equally.
senses.exampleCN: 这个社团以民主方式决定平分工作。
senses.why: The habit of voting can live in a small room as well as in a nation.
senses.whyCN: 投票的习惯既住在一个国家里，也住在一间小屋里。

intro.en: Democratic adds the Greek adjective ending -ic to democrat, which comes from demos, the people, and kratia, rule.
intro.cn: democratic 是 democrat 加上希腊形容词词尾 -ic；democrat 由 demos（人民）与 kratia（统治）组成。

items.en: Demokratia joined demos, the people, with kratia, rule.
items.cn: demokratia 由 demos（人民）与 kratia（统治）合成。

items.en: Athenian writers used demokratikos for things belonging to popular rule.
items.cn: 雅典作家用 demokratikos 形容属于民众统治的事物。

items.en: Latin authors borrowed the Greek adjective in discussions of constitutions.
items.cn: 拉丁作家在讨论政体时借用了这个希腊形容词。

items.en: English formed democratic to describe power held by the people.
items.cn: 英语造出 democratic，用来形容由人民掌握的权力。

items.en: Today it also describes any group that shares decisions fairly.
items.cn: 如今它也形容任何公平分享决定的群体。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the demo- opening, and the meaning group offers words for equal power and for standing in for others.
note.cn: 形近组都以 demo- 开头，近义组则给出表示平等权力与代表他人的词。

entries.definition: a person who believes in rule by the people
a system of government by the people
entries.definitionCN: 由人民治理的政治制度

entries.definition: the study of populations
chosen to speak for a group of people
entries.definitionCN: 被选出来代表一群人的

entries.definition: believing that all people should be equal
belonging to the ordinary people

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a circle of chairs and end with a decision that no single person could make alone.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一圈椅子开始，落到一个谁也独自做不出的决定。

normal.en: A circle of chairs has no head and no foot.
normal.cn: 围成一圈的椅子，没有头也没有尾。

normal.en: If one hand is always the only one raised, the room is not democratic.
normal.cn: 如果永远只有一只手举起，这间屋子就不民主。

normal.en: The word carries a Greek crowd inside it.
normal.cn: 这个词里装着一群希腊人。

normal.en: A vote in a classroom is small, but the habit is the same size as a nation.
normal.cn: 教室里的投票很小，习惯却和一个国家一样大。

normal.en: Demo- means people, so democratic means the people hold the pen.
normal.cn: demo- 是人民，democratic 就是人民握着笔。

abstract.en: Picture a hand count where every arm moves at the same time.
abstract.cn: 想象一次举手表决，所有手臂同时抬起。

abstract.en: Picture a rule book with one page that says no one is above it.
abstract.cn: 想象一本规则手册，其中一页写着没有人高过它。

abstract.en: Picture a small club where the leader also washes the cups.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小社团，负责人也要去洗杯子。

examples.en: The country held its first democratic election in decades.
examples.cn: 这个国家举行了几十年来第一次民主选举。

examples.en: The club made a democratic decision to share the work equally.
examples.cn: 这个社团以民主方式决定平分工作。

examples.en: A democratic classroom lets students disagree with the teacher.
examples.cn: 民主的课堂允许学生不同意老师。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 democratic 记成「得摸克拉提克」：demo 是人民，crat 是统治，ic 是形容词尾，人民统治的，就是民主的。

root: 来自希腊语 demokratikos，由 demos（人民）与 kratia（统治）再加形容词词尾 -ic 构成，经拉丁语与法语进入英语。它本指与人民统治有关的事物，后来也用来形容任何讲究平等参与的做法。

sensesIntro.en: From a nation that counts its votes, to a small room where every member counts once.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个清点选票的国家，到一间每个成员都只算一票的小屋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a circle of chairs where no seat is higher than another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一圈椅子，没有哪一张比别的更高。

branches.en: The first sense is a state whose power starts with votes.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是权力起始于选票的国家。

branches.en: The second sense is a room where every member counts once.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是每个成员都只算一票的屋子。

branches.en: A country and a club share the same test: who gets to speak.
branches.cn: 国家与社团面对同一道考题：谁有资格说话。

branches.en: The word also says who the power belongs to: the people, not a family.
branches.cn: 这个词也说明权力属于谁：属于人民，不属于某个家族。

branches.en: Used in small groups, it simply means no one sits above the vote.
branches.cn: 用在小组里，它只是说没有人坐在投票之上。

intro.en: Democratic grows a family of nouns and verbs about rule by the people and the act of opening a group to all.
intro.cn: democratic 长出一族名词与动词，讲人民统治，也讲把一个群体向所有人打开。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base is demos, the people, joined to kratia, rule, and then to the Latin adjective ending -ic.
latinIntro.cn: 它的希腊词基是 demos（人民）与 kratia（统治），后面接上形容词词尾 -ic。

items.meaning: based on equal power for all

items.exampleCN: 民主制度需要耐心的公民。

items.meaning: a believer in rule by the people
items.exampleCN: 他一生都是民主主义者。

items.meaning: in a fair and equal way
items.exampleCN: 领导者是以民主方式选出的。

items.meaning: to make something open to all
items.exampleCN: 他们把社团规则民主化了。

items.example: They voted for a social democratic party.
items.exampleCN: 他们投票给社会民主党。

definition_en: to show how something works, to prove a fact, or to gather in public protest
core_image: 讲台上的人举起一个装置，向所有人展示它怎样运转
scene: 实验室里，学生把一壶水烧开，让蒸汽推动小轮子转起来。The teacher demonstrated how the pump works.
sceneCN: 这里 demonstrate 指「演示」（第 1 个义项：把做法或运转方式展示给人看）；句意是老师演示了这台泵如何工作。

senses.title: Show how something works
senses.definition: to show someone how to do something or how a thing works
senses.definitionCN: 向某人展示做法或某物如何运转
senses.example: The teacher demonstrated how the pump works.
senses.exampleCN: 老师演示了这台泵如何工作。
senses.why: A thing understood by the eye is faster than a page of words.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛看懂的东西，比一页文字来得快。

senses.title: Prove with evidence
senses.definition: to show clearly that something is true
senses.definitionCN: 清楚地表明某事为真
senses.example: The study demonstrates a link between sleep and memory.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究证明了睡眠与记忆之间的联系。
senses.why: A proof is a showing that leaves no room for doubt.
senses.whyCN: 证明就是让人没有余地怀疑的展示。

senses.title: March in public protest
senses.definition: to gather in public to show strong disagreement
senses.definitionCN: 在公共场合聚集以表达强烈反对
senses.example: Thousands demonstrated against the new tax.
senses.exampleCN: 数千人示威反对这项新税。
senses.why: A crowd also demonstrates when it shows its opinion in the street.
senses.whyCN: 人群走上街头把意见展示出来，也是一种示威。

intro.en: Demonstrate comes from Latin monstrare, to show, with de- adding force; it entered English through the schools.
intro.cn: demonstrate 来自拉丁语 monstrare（展示），前缀 de- 加强语气，经学术用语进入英语。

items.en: Monstrare meant to point out or show, and de- added force to it.
items.cn: monstrare 意为指出或展示，de- 给它加上力度。

items.en: Scholars used demonstrare for proving a point by clear signs.
items.cn: 学者用 demonstrare 表示以清楚的迹象证明一点。

items.en: English took demonstrate for showing a fact by argument or experiment.
items.cn: 英语借来 demonstrate，指用论证或实验展示一个事实。

items.en: The sense of marching in public grew with mass politics.
items.cn: 随着大众政治兴起，走上街头这一层意思长了出来。

items.en: It now covers proof, teaching and street protest alike.
items.cn: 如今它同时覆盖证明、教学与街头抗议。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the demonstr- stem, and the meaning group moves from showing to proving to protesting.
note.cn: 形近组共用 demonstr- 这个词干，近义组则从展示走到证明，再走到抗议。

normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只手转动小轮子开始，落到街上举着牌子的人群。

normal.en: A pump shown once teaches more than a page of description.

normal.en: A crowd with signs is also showing something, only louder.
normal.cn: 举牌的人群也在展示，只是声音更大。

normal.en: Monstrare is the old word for pointing at a thing.
normal.cn: monstrare 就是古时候「指着某物」的说法。

normal.en: The teacher demonstrates, the student repeats, the fact stays.
normal.cn: 老师演示，学生重复，事实就留下了。

abstract.en: Picture a finger pointing at a wheel that begins to turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指指着一个开始转动的轮子。

abstract.en: Picture a chart laid flat so everyone can see the same line.
abstract.cn: 想象一张图表被摊平，让所有人都看见同一条线。

abstract.en: Picture a row of signs lifted above a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象一排牌子被举到人群之上。

examples.cn: 老师演示了这台泵如何工作。

examples.cn: 这项研究证明了睡眠与记忆之间的联系。

examples.en: Thousands demonstrated against the new tax.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 demonstrate 记成「demo 加 strate」：demo 是展示，把事情摆到台面上给人看，就是演示与证明。

root: 来自拉丁语 demonstrare，由 de-（加强）与 monstrare（指出、展示）组成。它先用于以清楚迹象证明一个论点，十六世纪进入英语后泛指展示；十九世纪大众政治兴起，又添上走上街头表达反对的意思。

sensesIntro.en: From a hand showing a working model, to a study proving a fact, to a crowd showing its anger.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一只手展示运转的模型，到一项研究证明事实，再到人群展示愤怒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand lifts a small machine so every eye can follow it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手举起小机器，让每双眼睛都能跟上。

branches.en: The first sense is a model shown until the working is clear.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把模型展示到运转方式变清楚。

branches.en: The second sense is a fact placed where no one can miss it.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把事实摆到没人能忽略的位置。

branches.en: The third sense is an opinion carried into the street.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把意见带到街上。

branches.en: Showing and proving both depend on making something visible.
branches.cn: 展示与证明都靠把某样东西变得可见。

branches.en: A sign in a march is also evidence of what people feel.
branches.cn: 游行中的一块牌子，也是人们感受的证据。

intro.en: Demonstrate has a Latin spine and grows nouns for the act, the person and the quality of being provable.
intro.cn: demonstrate 有一根拉丁脊梁，长出了表示行为、人物与可证明性的名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is monstrare, to show; de- strengthens it and -tion turns the act into a noun.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词基是 monstrare（展示），de- 加强语气，-tion 把行为变成名词。

definition_en: a public march or gathering in protest, or an act of showing and proving something
core_image: 街上一群人举着纸牌缓慢前行，纸牌上的字写得很大
scene: 广场上人群举着写满字的纸板，警察在两边维持秩序。The demonstration outside the factory stayed peaceful all day.
sceneCN: 这里 demonstration 指「示威游行」（第 1 个义项：为表达反对而举行的公众集会或游行）；句意是工厂外的示威整天保持和平。

senses.title: A public protest
senses.definition: a public march or gathering to show strong disagreement
senses.definitionCN: 为表达强烈反对而举行的公众游行或集会
senses.example: The demonstration outside the factory stayed peaceful all day.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂外的示威整天保持和平。
senses.why: When words are not heard, people carry them into the street.
senses.whyCN: 话没人听，人们就把它举到街上。

senses.title: A practical showing
senses.definition: a practical showing of how something works
senses.definitionCN: 对某物如何运转的实际展示
senses.example: The cook gave a demonstration of the new oven.
senses.exampleCN: 厨师演示了新烤箱的用法。
senses.why: A demonstration puts the working model in front of the eyes.
senses.whyCN: 演示就是把运转中的模型摆到眼前。

senses.title: A clear proof
senses.definition: a clear proof of a fact or a feeling
senses.definitionCN: 对事实或感情的清楚证明
senses.example: Her calm was a demonstration of real courage.
senses.exampleCN: 她的镇定是真正勇气的证明。
senses.why: A proof is a demonstration that the case has been made.
senses.whyCN: 证明就是表明理由已经站住了的展示。

intro.en: Demonstration is the Latin noun for a pointing out, built from monstrare, to show, with de- adding force.

items.en: Demonstratio named the act of pointing something out.
items.cn: demonstratio 指把某物指出来这个动作。

items.en: Writers used it for a proof built from clear signs.
items.cn: 作家用它指由清楚迹象构成的证明。

items.en: English took the noun for showing and explaining.

items.en: The word was applied to crowds marching in protest.

sensesIntro.en: From a crowd carrying signs, to a table showing a machine, to a fact shown beyond doubt.

examples.cn: 好牙医会解释钻头要做什么。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dentist 记成「凳子上的齿科人」：dent 是牙，ist 是人，坐在那张凳子上替你治牙的人就是牙医。

root: 来自法语 dentiste，由 dent（牙齿）与 -iste（从事某事的人）组成。十八世纪牙科从普通医学里独立出来，这个词随职业一起进入英语；十九世纪执照与学校出现后，它专指受过训练的牙医。

sensesIntro.en: From the person holding the mirror to the room where the chair waits.
sensesIntro.cn: 从那个拿着小镜子的人，到那张椅子等着的房间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a masked face under a bright lamp above an open mouth.
core.cn: 核心意象：亮灯之下，一张口罩遮住的脸俯向张开的嘴。

branches.en: The first sense is the person who does the looking and the fixing.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那个负责查看与修补的人。

branches.en: The second sense is the room named after that person.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是以那个人命名的房间。

branches.en: A trade and its workplace often borrow a single name.
branches.cn: 一门手艺和它的场所，常常共用一个名字。

branches.en: The word points at a trained professional, not just anyone with a mirror.
branches.cn: 这个词指的是受过训练的专业人士，不是随便拿面镜子的人。

branches.en: Going to the dentist can mean the chair, the bill and the wait.
branches.cn: 去看牙医，可能意味着椅子、账单和等待。

intro.en: Dentist belongs to the tooth family and names the person at its centre.
intro.cn: dentist 属于牙齿家族，并给这个家族的中心人物命名。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin dens, tooth, with the stem dent- and the agent ending -ist.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 dens（牙齿），词干 dent- 后面加表示人的词尾 -ist。

items.meaning: the work and study of teeth
items.example: She studied dentistry for five years.
Dental care matters at every age.
items.exampleCN: 牙齿护理在每个年龄都重要。
这些病人在牙齿状况上相似。

items.example: He cleaned his denture each night.

items.meaning: the clinic where a dentist works
items.example: I left my bag at the dentist's.
items.exampleCN: 我把包落在牙医诊所了。

definition_en: to say that something is not true, or to refuse to give something to someone
core_image: 一个人把递到面前的文件推回去，摇了摇头
scene: 记者连问三次，发言人每次都把同一句话重复一遍，眼睛没有离开稿子。The company denied that it had broken the law.
sceneCN: 这里 deny 指「否认」（第 1 个义项：说某事不是真的）；句意是公司否认自己违反了法律。

senses.title: Say it is not true
senses.definition: to state that something is not true
senses.definitionCN: 声明某事不是真的
senses.example: The company denied that it had broken the law.
senses.exampleCN: 公司否认自己违反了法律。
senses.why: A denial pushes a claim back before it can settle.
senses.whyCN: 否认就是把说法在落定之前推回去。

senses.title: Refuse to give
senses.definition: to refuse to allow or give something
senses.definitionCN: 拒绝允许或给予某物
senses.example: He was denied entry to the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 他被拒绝进入大厅。
senses.why: To deny a thing is to shut a door and keep it shut.
senses.whyCN: 拒绝给予，就是关上一扇门并不再打开。

intro.en: Deny came through Old French denier from Latin denegare, where de- means fully and negare means to say no.
intro.cn: deny 经古法语 denier 来自拉丁语 denegare，其中 de- 表示完全，negare 表示说不。

items.en: Denegare joined de-, meaning fully, with negare, to say no.
items.cn: denegare 由 de-（完全）与 negare（说不）合成。

items.en: Writers used denegare for refusing a request or a faith.
items.cn: 作家用 denegare 表示拒绝请求或背弃信仰。

items.en: Denier refused, forbade or said a thing was untrue.
items.cn: denier 可以表示拒绝、禁止，或说某事不实。

items.en: English took deny for both refusing and declaring false.
items.cn: 英语借来 deny，同时表示拒绝与宣布为假。

items.en: Today a person can deny a fact or be denied a chance.
items.cn: 如今人可以否认一个事实，也可能被剥夺一个机会。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the deny stem, and the meaning group moves from refusing a request to rejecting a statement.
note.cn: 形近组共用 deny 词干，近义组则从拒绝请求走到否掉一个说法。

entries.definition: a statement that something is not true
able to be said not to be true
a person who says something is false
to say you will not do or give something
to refuse to accept something
to say the opposite of what was said

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a document pushed back across a table and end with a door that stays closed.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一份被推回桌对面的文件开始，落到一扇始终关着的门。

normal.en: A shaken head is the shortest denial.
normal.cn: 摇一下头，就是最短的否认。

normal.en: Deny has two hands: one pushes a claim away, one withholds a gift.
normal.cn: deny 有两只手：一只推开说法，一只扣住东西不给。

normal.en: To deny a child a story is to shut a small door.
normal.cn: 不给孩子讲一个故事，就是关上一扇小小的门。

normal.en: A firm denial is a wall built in one sentence.
normal.cn: 一句坚决的否认，就是一句话砌成的一堵墙。

normal.en: Deny and denial differ only in their ending.
normal.cn: deny 与 denial 只差一个词尾。

abstract.en: Picture a palm pressing a sheet of paper flat on a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掌把一张纸按平在桌上。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing around a key and putting it away.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手攥住钥匙，把它收了起来。

abstract.en: Picture a doorway with a person standing in it, arms crossed.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站在门口，双臂交叉。

examples.en: The company denied that it had broken the law.
examples.cn: 公司否认自己违反了法律。

examples.en: He was denied entry to the hall.
examples.cn: 他被拒绝进入大厅。

examples.en: There is no denying that the plan has failed.
examples.cn: 不可否认，这个计划已经失败。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 deny 记成「抵赖」：de 像「抵」，ny 像「赖」，把做过的事抵掉不认，就是否认。

root: 来自拉丁语 denegare，由 de-（完全）与 negare（说不）组成，经古法语 denier 进入英语。它先同时表示拒绝请求与宣布某事不实，后来两条线都保留下来：一条说「这不是真的」，一条说「这个不给你」。

sensesIntro.en: From pushing a claim back across the table to closing the door on a request.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把说法推回桌对面，到对请求关上大门。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet of paper pushed back and a head shaking once.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份文件被推回来，一颗头摇了一下。

branches.en: The first sense is a wall built against a statement.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是针对一个说法砌起的墙。

branches.en: The second sense is a closed hand, not an argument.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一只攥紧的手，不是一场辩论。

branches.en: Both senses say no, one to a fact and one to a request.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在说不，一个对事实，一个对请求。

branches.en: In argument, deny means the other side has not proved its case.
branches.cn: 在争论里，deny 意味着对方没有证明自己的说法。

branches.en: In daily life, deny means a chance is taken away.
branches.cn: 在日常里，deny 意味着一个机会被拿走了。

intro.en: Deny grows a family of nouns and adjectives about saying no and about what cannot be said no to.
intro.cn: deny 长出一族名词与形容词，讲说不，也讲不容说不。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin negare, to say no, strengthened by de-.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词基是拉丁语 negare（说不），前面用 de- 加强。

items.meaning: to say no to a claim or a request
items.example: She denied the charge at once.

items.meaning: a statement that something is false
items.exampleCN: 他的否认没说服任何人。
这个说法几乎无法否认。

items.meaning: in a way that cannot be denied

items.exampleCN: 否认者重复了他的说法。
这张便条给了他推脱的余地。

items.meaning: in a way that can be denied
items.exampleCN: 这道命令含糊得可以否认。

definition_zh: 部门；系；百货商店的专柜区
definition_en: one of the parts into which a large organization is divided
core_image: 一栋大楼的平面图被切成许多小格，每格亮着一盏灯
scene: 商场二楼挂满衣服，三楼摆着锅碗，指示牌把每层分成几块。She works in the sales department of a small company.
sceneCN: 这里 department 指「部门」（第 1 个义项：大机构划分出的部分）；句意是她在小公司的销售部工作。

pos.zh: 部门；系；百货商店的专柜区

senses.title: A division of an organization
senses.definition: one of the parts into which a large organization is divided
senses.definitionCN: 大机构被划分成的部分之一
senses.example: She works in the sales department of a small company.
senses.exampleCN: 她在小公司的销售部工作。
senses.why: When an organization grows past one table, it begins to cut itself into parts.
senses.whyCN: 当一个机构一张桌子坐不下，它就开始把自己切成几块。

senses.title: A subject area at a university
senses.definition: a group of teachers and courses in one subject
senses.definitionCN: 同一学科的老师与课程组成的单位
senses.example: She teaches in the history department.
senses.exampleCN: 她在历史系任教。
senses.why: A university is also too large for one voice, so it divides by subject.
senses.whyCN: 大学也大到容不下一个声音，于是按学科分开。

senses.title: A section of a large shop
senses.definition: one of the areas of a large shop that sells a kind of goods
senses.definitionCN: 大商店里售卖某一类商品的区域
senses.example: The store has a whole department for kitchen goods.
senses.exampleCN: 这家商店有一整块区域卖厨房用品。
senses.why: A shop that sells everything must sort itself like a small city.
senses.whyCN: 什么都卖的商店，得像座小城那样把自己归类。

intro.en: Department came from French département, which grew out of départir, to divide or share out.
intro.cn: department 来自法语 département，而它又由 départir（划分、分配）长出来。

items.en: Departement came from departir, to divide or share out.
items.cn: departement 来自 departir，意为划分或分配。

items.en: The word named an administrative division of the state.
items.cn: 这个词指国家的行政区划。

items.en: English took department for a branch of government or business.
items.cn: 英语借来 department，指政府或企业的分支。

items.en: Universities and shops borrowed it for their own divisions.
items.cn: 大学与商店也借它来称呼自己的分区。

items.en: Now any large body can be cut into departments.
items.cn: 如今任何大的机构都能被切成部门。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the depart stem, and the meaning group gives three words for a part of something larger.
note.cn: 形近组共用 depart 词干，近义组则给出三个表示「大东西的一部分」的词。

entries.definitionCN: 某物被分成的部分之一

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a floor plan cut into rooms and end with a shop that sorts everything by kind.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从被切成一个个房间的平面图开始，落到按类别整理万物的商店。

normal.en: A department is a slice of a big building.
normal.cn: 部门就是一栋大楼切下来的一片。

normal.en: The sign on the door tells you which slice you are in.
normal.cn: 门上的牌子告诉你，你在哪一片里。

normal.en: A university divides by subject, a shop by goods.
normal.cn: 大学按学科分，商店按货物分。

normal.en: Department and departure share the same parting root.
normal.cn: department 与 departure 共用同一个「分开」的词根。

normal.en: Too many people in one room is how departments begin.
normal.cn: 一间屋子挤了太多人，部门就是这样开始的。

abstract.en: Picture a map of a building with each room lit a different colour.
abstract.cn: 想象一张楼内地图，每个房间亮着不同颜色。

abstract.en: Picture a long corridor with names painted above every door.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长走廊，每扇门上方都刷着名字。

abstract.en: Picture shelves sorted until nothing is out of place.
abstract.cn: 想象货架被整理到没有一样东西放错。

examples.en: She works in the sales department of a small company.
examples.cn: 她在小公司的销售部工作。

examples.en: She teaches in the history department.
examples.cn: 她在历史系任教。

examples.en: The store has a whole department for kitchen goods.
examples.cn: 这家商店有一整块区域卖厨房用品。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 department 记成「地面切成块」：de 是分开，part 是部分，一个大机构被分成一块块，就是部门。

root: 来自法语 département，源头是 départir（划分、分配）。它先指国家的行政区划，十八世纪进入英语后指政府或企业的分支，十九世纪又被大学与商店借去称呼各自的划分。

sensesIntro.en: From an office divided by function, to a university divided by subject, to a shop divided by goods.
sensesIntro.cn: 从按职能划分的办公室，到按学科划分的大学，再到按货物划分的商店。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a floor plan cut into rooms, each with its own lamp.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张被切成房间的平面图，每间亮着自己的灯。

branches.en: The first sense is work cut into manageable parts.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把工作切成管得过来的几块。

branches.en: The second sense is knowledge cut by subject.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把知识按学科切开。

branches.en: The third sense is goods cut by kind.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把货物按种类分开。

branches.en: An office and a university both divide because one voice cannot hold everything.
branches.cn: 办公室与大学都要划分，因为一个声音装不下所有事。

branches.en: A subject and a shelf are both sorting devices.
branches.cn: 学科与货架，都是分类的工具。

intro.en: Department belongs to the parting family and carries the idea of division into organized life.
intro.cn: department 属于「分开」这一族，把划分的观念带进组织生活。

latinIntro.en: The base is partire, to divide, seen also in part and partial.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词基是 partire（划分），在 part 与 partial 里也能看到。

items.meaning: a part of a large organization
items.example: She works in the sales department.
The departmental meeting is at nine.

items.exampleCN: 他们组成了一个跨部门团队。
他们把整个办公室按部门划分了。

items.meaning: a large shop with many sections

definition_en: the act of leaving a place, or a change away from what is usual
core_image: 机场大屏上一行行航班变成灰色，登机口空了下来
scene: 广播念出航班号，候机的人陆续站起来，椅子一排排空下去。Her departure left the office very quiet.
sceneCN: 这里 departure 指「离开」（第 1 个义项：离开某地的行为）；句意是她的离开让办公室安静下来。

senses.title: The act of leaving
senses.definition: the act of going away from a place
senses.definitionCN: 从某地走开的行为
senses.example: Her departure left the office very quiet.
senses.exampleCN: 她的离开让办公室安静下来。
senses.why: A leaving is felt most by the people who stay.
senses.whyCN: 离开这件事，留在原地的人感受最深。

senses.title: The start of a journey
senses.definition: the moment when a journey or flight begins
senses.definitionCN: 旅程或航班开始的时刻
senses.example: The departure time is printed on the ticket.
senses.exampleCN: 票上印着出发时间。
senses.why: A journey has to be dated from somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 旅程总得从一个时刻算起。

senses.title: A turn away from the old
senses.definition: a change that leaves the usual way behind
senses.definitionCN: 离开通常做法的改变
senses.example: The new design is a departure from tradition.
senses.exampleCN: 新设计是对传统的一次背离。
senses.why: Not every departure needs a station; an idea can leave too.
senses.whyCN: 不是每次离开都需要车站，想法也会出走。

intro.en: Departure grew from French départir, to divide or leave, and added the noun ending -ure.
intro.cn: departure 从法语 départir（划分、离开）长出来，后面加了名词词尾 -ure。

items.en: Departir meant to divide, to separate or to leave.
items.cn: departir 表示划分、分开或离开。

items.en: Departure named a separation or a going away.
items.cn: departure 指一次分离或一次走开。

items.en: English used departure for the act of leaving.
items.cn: 英语用 departure 表示离开这一行为。

items.en: Travel gave it a fixed place beside arrival.
items.cn: 旅行让它与到达并列，各占一头。

items.en: Now it also covers leaving a job or an old method.
items.cn: 如今它也指离开一份工作或一种旧方法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the depart stem, and the meaning group names leaving from several angles.
note.cn: 形近组共用 depart 词干，近义组则从几个角度说离开。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a board of greyed-out flights and end with an idea walking away from an old rule.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一块变灰的航班牌开始，落到一个离开旧规则的想法。

normal.en: An empty gate is a departure you can see.
normal.cn: 空着的登机口，是一场看得见的离开。

normal.en: A ticket has two times: one for leaving, one for arriving.
normal.cn: 一张票有两个时间：一个离开，一个到达。

normal.en: The people who stay hear the door close longest.
normal.cn: 留在原地的人，听关门声听得最久。

normal.en: A departure from tradition needs no suitcase.
normal.cn: 背离传统，不需要行李箱。

normal.en: Departure is the noun that turns departing into a thing.
normal.cn: departure 就是把离开变成一件事的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a row of chairs with coats lifted off them.

abstract.en: Picture a gate number still glowing after the flight has gone.

abstract.en: Picture a road forking away from a straight line.

examples.en: The departure time is printed on the ticket.

examples.en: The new design is a departure from tradition.
examples.cn: 新设计是对传统的一次背离。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 departure 记成「分开的车」：depart 是离开，ure 是名词尾，车一开走，就是一场离开。

sensesIntro.en: From a gate that empties, to a time printed on a ticket, to a design that leaves the old path.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gate number glows above a row of empty chairs.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排空椅子上方，登机口号码还亮着。

branches.en: The first sense is the plain fact of someone going.

branches.en: The second sense is the clock time when a journey starts.

branches.en: The third sense is a method or habit left behind.

branches.en: Every journey begins as a leaving, with a time attached.

branches.en: A person and a design can both depart from what was expected.

intro.en: Departure is the noun of leaving, standing beside depart and the whole parting family.

latinIntro.en: The base is partire, to divide; -ure turns the act into a noun.

core_image: 一根细杆斜靠在墙上，整面重量都压在墙那一点
scene: 老桥的一侧靠在山壁上，另一侧悬着，木板随脚步轻响。Whether we go out depends on the weather.
sceneCN: 这里 depend 指「取决于」（第 2 个义项：由某事决定）；句意是我们是否出门取决于天气。

senses.title: Need support
senses.definition: to need someone or something in order to manage
senses.definitionCN: 为了应付需要某人或某物
senses.example: Young children depend on their parents for food.
senses.exampleCN: 幼儿依靠父母获得食物。
senses.why: A thing that leans cannot stand without the thing it leans on.
senses.whyCN: 靠着别人的东西，离了那面墙就站不住。

senses.title: Be decided by
senses.definition: to be decided or affected by something else
senses.definitionCN: 由另一件事决定或受影响
senses.example: Whether we go out depends on the weather.
senses.exampleCN: 我们是否出门取决于天气。
senses.why: The answer is not in the question; it waits in another fact.
senses.whyCN: 答案不在问题里，而在另一个事实那里等着。

senses.title: Trust someone
senses.definition: to trust someone to do what is needed
senses.definitionCN: 相信某人会做好该做的事
senses.example: You can depend on her to keep a secret.
senses.exampleCN: 你可以信赖她保守秘密。
senses.why: Trust is leaning on a person and finding them solid.
senses.whyCN: 信任就是靠上一个人，发现他站得住。

intro.en: Depend comes from Latin dependere, to hang down, built from de-, down, and pendere, to hang.
intro.cn: depend 来自拉丁语 dependere（悬垂），由 de-（向下）与 pendere（悬挂）组成。

items.en: Dependere meant to hang down or hang from something.
items.cn: dependere 意为垂下或从某物上悬挂。

items.en: Writers used it for things that rested on other things.
items.cn: 作家用它指依附在别的东西上的事物。

items.en: English took depend for leaning on support.
items.cn: 英语借来 depend，表示倚靠支撑。

items.en: It grew the sense of being decided by a condition.
items.cn: 它长出了「由某个条件决定」的意思。

items.en: Now it covers need, condition and trust.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖需要、条件与信任。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the pend- stem of hanging, and the meaning group gives three ways of leaning on something.
note.cn: 形近组共用表示悬挂的 pend- 词干，近义组则给出三种倚靠的说法。

normal.en: De- is down and pend- is hang: to depend is to hang from something.

normal.en: A bridge that leans on a cliff does not argue with the cliff.

normal.en: The answer depends on a fact you have not checked yet.
normal.cn: 答案取决于一个你还没去核实的事实。

normal.en: A dependable person is a wall that does not move.

abstract.cn: 想象一把梯子只靠在一道窄窄的凸沿上。

abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯只由一根线吊着。

abstract.en: Picture two people walking, one holding the other's arm.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 depend 记成「吊在下面」：pend 是悬挂，de 是向下，整个人吊在别人身上，就是依靠。

root: 来自拉丁语 dependere，由 de-（向下）与 pendere（悬挂）组成。本义是垂下、从某物上悬挂，后来引申为倚靠支撑；十七世纪又长出「由某个条件决定」的意思，现代还用来表示对人的信赖。

sensesIntro.en: From a pole leaning on a wall, to an answer waiting on a fact, to a person you can trust.
sensesIntro.cn: 从靠在墙上的杆子，到等一个事实的答案，再到一个可以信任的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin pole leans and gives all its weight to one wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根细杆斜靠着，把全部重量交给一面墙。

branches.en: The first sense is weight resting on another thing.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是重量落在另一样东西上。

branches.en: The second sense is a result waiting on a condition.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是结果在等一个条件。

branches.en: The third sense is a person who will hold when you lean.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是你靠上去时撑得住的人。

branches.en: A bridge and an answer both rest on something outside themselves.
branches.cn: 桥与答案，都落在自身之外的某样东西上。

branches.en: To depend on a fact and on a friend are two kinds of trust.
branches.cn: 依赖一个事实与依赖一个朋友，是两种信任。

intro.en: Depend has a large family of hanging and leaning words, from dependence to independence.
intro.cn: depend 有一大族表示悬挂与倚靠的词，从依赖一直到独立。

latinIntro.en: The base is pendere, to hang, with de- meaning down; the same root gives pendant and suspend.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 pendere（悬挂），de- 表示向下；同一词根还给出 pendant 与 suspend。

senses.title: Needing support
senses.definition: needing someone or something in order to live or work

senses.example: The plant is dependent on light from the window.
senses.exampleCN: 这株植物依赖窗外的光。
senses.why: A plant in a window turns toward what it cannot make for itself.
senses.whyCN: 窗边的植物会转向它自己造不出来的东西。

senses.title: Decided by something
senses.definition: decided or affected by something else
senses.definitionCN: 由另一件事决定或受其影响的
senses.example: The price is dependent on the season.
senses.exampleCN: 价格取决于季节。
senses.why: A dependent price has no will of its own.
senses.whyCN: 取决于别处的价格，没有自己的主意。

senses.title: A person who is supported
senses.definition: a person, often a child, who is supported by another
senses.definitionCN: 由他人供养的人，常指孩子
senses.example: The policy helps workers with dependents.
senses.exampleCN: 这项政策帮助有受抚养人的工作者。
senses.why: The noun names the one who leans, not the leaning.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词命名的是靠着的人，而不是靠着这件事。

intro.en: Dependent is the adjective formed from Latin dependere, to hang from, with the ending -ent.
intro.cn: dependent 由拉丁语 dependere（悬挂于）加形容词词尾 -ent 构成。

items.en: Dependere meant to hang down from a support.
items.cn: dependere 意为从支撑物上垂下。

items.en: The adjective dependens described what hung from something.
items.cn: 形容词 dependens 形容从某物上悬着的东西。

items.en: English used dependent for leaning on support.
items.cn: 英语用 dependent 表示倚靠支撑。

items.en: Grammar borrowed the word for a clause that needs another.
items.cn: 语法学借它指需要另一句才能成立的从句。

items.en: Now it also names a person who is supported.
items.cn: 如今它也指一个由他人供养的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the depend stem, and the meaning group gives words for relying and for being conditional.
note.cn: 形近组共用 depend 词干，近义组则给出表示依靠与有条件的词。

normal.en: A vine with no pole has nowhere to climb.

normal.en: A dependent price is a leaf in the wind.

normal.en: The noun dependent means the person, not the need.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dependent 记成「吊着的人」：depend 是悬挂依靠，ent 是人或物，吊在别人身上的，就是依赖的。

root: 来自拉丁语 dependere（悬挂于）加形容词词尾 -ent。它先形容从支撑物上垂下的东西，十五世纪进入英语表示倚靠，十八世纪语法学借它指需要另一句的从句，现代又用作名词指受抚养的人。

sensesIntro.en: From a vine on a pole, to a price on a season, to a child in someone's care.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vine hangs all its weight on one bamboo pole.

branches.en: The first sense is living support, the way a vine needs a pole.

branches.en: The second sense is a result that moves with another fact.

branches.en: The third sense turns the adjective into a person.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这个形容词变成了一个人。

branches.en: Plants and prices both answer to something outside themselves.

branches.en: A dependent person and a dependent price both lack a free hand.
branches.cn: 受抚养的人与取决于别处的价格，都没有自由的手。

definition_en: to put money into a bank or account, money paid as a first part, or material laid down by water
core_image: 一枚硬币落进铁盒，盒底已经有薄薄一层
scene: 房东数完钱，把一张收据推过来，说钥匙可以拿了。She deposited the money and kept the receipt.
sceneCN: 这里 deposit 指「存入」（第 1 个义项：把钱放进银行或账户）；句意是她把钱存进去并保留了收据。

senses.title: Put money in for keeping
senses.definition: to put money into a bank or an account
senses.definitionCN: 把钱放进银行或账户
senses.example: She deposited the money and kept the receipt.
senses.exampleCN: 她把钱存进去并保留了收据。
senses.why: Money put down in a safe place is money set apart from the pocket.
senses.whyCN: 放进安全地方的钱，就是与口袋分开的钱。

senses.title: Money paid as a first part
senses.definition: money paid first as a promise or a security
senses.definitionCN: 先付的一笔作为承诺或担保的钱
senses.example: They paid a deposit on the flat.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为这套公寓付了押金。
senses.why: A deposit says the promise has weight.
senses.whyCN: 押金是在说，这个承诺有分量。

senses.title: Material laid down by water
senses.definition: material that water or wind leaves in a layer
senses.definitionCN: 水或风留下的一层物质
senses.example: The river left a deposit of sand at the bend.
senses.exampleCN: 河流在转弯处留下一层沙。
senses.why: Water carries what it cannot hold, and sets it down.
senses.whyCN: 水搬不动的东西，就放下来。

intro.en: Deposit comes from Latin depositum, a thing placed down, from deponere, built on ponere, to place.
intro.cn: deposit 来自拉丁语 depositum（放下之物），源头是 deponere，词基为 ponere（放置）。

items.en: Deponere joined de-, meaning down, with ponere, to place.
items.cn: deponere 由 de-（向下）与 ponere（放置）合成。

items.en: Depositum named a thing placed down or entrusted.
items.cn: depositum 指放下或托付之物。

items.en: English used deposit for money placed with a bank.
items.cn: 英语用 deposit 指存进银行的钱。

items.en: Science borrowed it for layers laid down by water.
items.cn: 科学借它指水留下的层状物。

items.en: Now it covers savings, security payments and sediment.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖储蓄、担保付款与沉积物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the deposit stem, and the meaning group moves from saving money to leaving matter behind.
note.cn: 形近组共用 deposit 词干，近义组则从存钱走到留下物质。

normal.en: A deposit is money told to sit down and wait.
normal.cn: 存款就是让钱坐下来等着。

normal.en: A deposit on a flat is a promise with a price.
normal.cn: 公寓的押金，是一个带价钱的承诺。

normal.en: A river deposits what it is too tired to carry.

abstract.en: Picture a receipt folded once and put in a pocket.
abstract.cn: 想象一张收据被折一下，塞进口袋。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line of sand along a river bend.
abstract.cn: 想象河湾边上薄薄的一道沙。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 deposit 记成「放到底」：de 是向下，pos 是放，把钱放到底下的安全处，就是存入与押金。

root: 来自拉丁语 depositum，源头是 deponere，由 de-（向下）与 ponere（放置）组成。它先指放下或托付之物，十六世纪进入英语指存进银行的钱，十七世纪科学又借它指水留下的沉积层。

sensesIntro.en: From money laid in a safe place, to money laid down as a promise, to sand laid down by a river.
sensesIntro.cn: 从放进安全处的钱，到作为承诺交出的钱，再到河流放下的沙。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coin falls into a tin that already has a thin layer in it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚硬币落进盒底已有一层薄薄东西的铁盒。

branches.en: The first sense is money placed where it will wait.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把钱放在一个会等你的地方。

branches.en: The second sense is money placed as proof of a promise.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是作为承诺凭据放下的钱。

branches.en: The third sense is matter placed by water and forgotten.

branches.en: In a bank and in a landlord's hand, money is put down for later.

branches.en: Both a pledge and a sandbank are things left in place.
branches.cn: 承诺的凭据与沙洲，都是留在原处的东西。

definition_en: a long feeling of sadness, a period of low economic activity, or a hollow in a surface
core_image: 一片凹下去的地面，雨水积在最低处，久久不退
scene: 雨停之后，操场中间积了一小片水，四周都比它高。The depression of the ground held water for days.
sceneCN: 这里 depression 指「凹陷」（第 3 个义项：表面上凹下去的地方）；句意是地面的凹陷把水留了好几天。

senses.title: A long feeling of sadness

senses.example: He has struggled with depression for years.
senses.exampleCN: 他与抑郁抗争了多年。
senses.why: Sadness that will not lift becomes an illness with a name.
senses.whyCN: 迟迟不散去的悲伤，成了一种有名字的病。

senses.title: A period of low business
senses.definition: a long period when business is bad and many lose work
