senses.example: The depression closed half the shops in town.
senses.exampleCN: 萧条让镇上半数店铺关了门。
senses.why: An economy can sink the way a floor can sink.
senses.whyCN: 经济会下沉，就像地面会下陷。

senses.title: A hollow in a surface
senses.definition: a place where a surface is pressed or worn down
senses.definitionCN: 表面被压下去或磨下去的地方
senses.example: The depression of the ground held water for days.
senses.exampleCN: 地面的凹陷把水留了好几天。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply a place pressed down.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思，就是一个被压下去的地方。

intro.en: Depression is the Latin noun depressio, from deprimere, to press down.
intro.cn: depression 是拉丁语名词 depressio，来自 deprimere（向下压）。

items.en: Deprimere meant to press down, from de- and premere.
items.cn: deprimere 意为向下压，由 de- 与 premere 组成。

items.en: Depressio named a sinking or a low place.
items.cn: depressio 指下陷或低洼处。

items.en: English used depression for a hollow or a lowering.
items.cn: 英语用 depression 表示凹陷或降低。

items.en: It described low spirits and, later, low trade.
items.cn: 它先形容低落的精神，后来又形容低迷的贸易。

items.en: The Great Depression fixed the economic sense worldwide.
items.cn: 大萧条让经济这一层意思在全世界固定下来。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the depress stem, and the meaning group gives a mood word, an economic word and a shape word.
note.cn: 形近组共用 depress 词干，近义组则分别给出情绪词、经济词与形状词。

entries.definition: to press down or make low
feeling very low
relating to low mood
the feeling of being unhappy
a period when business shrinks
an empty space inside something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with rain filling a low patch of ground and end with a shop that closes for good.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从雨水积在低洼处开始，落到一家再也不开门的店。

normal.en: Water finds the lowest place, and so does the word depression.
normal.cn: 水找最低处，depression 这个词也一样。

normal.en: A low economy and a low mood are both called a depression.
normal.cn: 低迷的经济与低落的心情，都叫 depression。

normal.en: A depression in the ground keeps what falls into it.
normal.cn: 地面的凹陷会留住落进去的东西。

normal.en: The Great Depression put the word on every front page.
normal.cn: 大萧条把这个词放上了每一份头版。

normal.en: Depression is the noun behind depress, depressed and depressive.
normal.cn: depression 是 depress、depressed 与 depressive 背后的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a shallow bowl of ground holding a mirror of water.
abstract.cn: 想象地上浅浅一只碗，盛着一面水镜。

abstract.en: Picture a street of shops with shutters down.
abstract.cn: 想象一条街的店铺都拉下了卷帘。

abstract.en: Picture a person sitting in a room with the curtains closed.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人坐在拉着窗帘的房间里。

examples.en: He has struggled with depression for years.
examples.cn: 他与抑郁抗争了多年。

examples.en: The depression closed half the shops in town.
examples.cn: 萧条让镇上半数店铺关了门。

examples.en: The depression of the ground held water for days.
examples.cn: 地面的凹陷把水留了好几天。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 depression 记成「地压深」：de 向下，press 压，ion 名词尾，地被压出一个深坑，就是凹陷，也指心情的低谷。

root: 来自拉丁语 depressio，源头是 deprimere（向下压）。它最早指地面上的低洼处，十四世纪进入英语；十七世纪起用来形容低落的精神与低迷的商业，二十世纪的大萧条让经济这一层意思传遍世界。

sensesIntro.en: From a hollow that holds rain, to a mood that will not lift, to an economy that will not move.
sensesIntro.cn: 从盛着雨水的凹陷，到迟迟不散的低落，再到迟迟不动经济。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rain gathers in the lowest patch and stays there.
core.cn: 核心意象：雨水聚在最低处，久久不退。

branches.en: The first sense is a mood with no way up.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是找不到出口的心情。

branches.en: The second sense is an economy stuck at a low level.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是卡在低位的经济。

branches.en: The third sense is the oldest: a place pressed below its edges.
branches.cn: 第三个义项最古老：一个低于四周的地方。

branches.en: Both a person and a market can be said to be in a depression.
branches.cn: 人与市场，都可以说陷在 depression 里。

branches.en: A low economy and a low patch of ground share the same picture.
branches.cn: 低迷的经济与低洼的地面，共用同一幅图。

intro.en: Depression is the noun at the centre of the pressing family, from the verb to the medical adjective.
intro.cn: depression 是「压」这一族词中心的名词，从动词一直连到医学形容词。

latinIntro.en: The base is premere, to press, with de- meaning down and -ion making a noun.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 premere（压），de- 表示向下，-ion 构成名词。

items.meaning: a low mood, a low economy or a hollow
to push down or make low
items.example: Do not depress the red switch.

items.meaning: in a way that lowers the mood
a substance that slows the body
a drug that lifts low mood
items.exampleCN: 医生给他换了抗抑郁药。

definition_en: the distance from top to bottom, or the quality of being deep and serious
core_image: 一根绳子被慢慢放下去，过了很久才触到底
scene: 船停在湖心，船夫把系着石头的绳子一点点放下去，直到手突然一松。The depth of the lake surprised the divers.
sceneCN: 这里 depth 指「深度」（第 1 个义项：从上到下的距离）；句意是湖的深度让潜水员吃惊。

senses.title: Distance downward
senses.definition: the distance from the top to the bottom of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物从顶部到底部的距离
senses.example: The depth of the lake surprised the divers.
senses.exampleCN: 湖的深度让潜水员吃惊。
senses.why: Depth is a distance you cannot see from the surface.
senses.whyCN: 深度是从表面看不见的一段距离。

senses.title: The deepest part
senses.definition: the deepest part of a place or thing
senses.definitionCN: 某地或某物最深的部分
senses.example: The fish live in the depths of the ocean.
senses.exampleCN: 这种鱼生活在海洋深处。
senses.why: A plural turns the measure into a place.
senses.whyCN: 复数把一种度量变成了一个地方。

senses.title: Seriousness of thought or feeling
senses.definition: the quality of being serious, strong or full of meaning
senses.definitionCN: 严肃、强烈或富有意涵的品质
senses.example: The book has a depth that rewards a second reading.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书有一种值得再读一遍的深刻。
senses.why: A mind, like water, can be shallow or deep.
senses.whyCN: 人的心思像水，可以浅，也可以深。

intro.en: Depth is Old English deop, deep, with the old suffix -th that also makes length and warmth.
intro.cn: depth 是古英语 deop（深）加上古老的名词词尾 -th，length 与 warmth 也是这么来的。

items.en: Deop meant deep, and the suffix -th turned it into a measure.
items.cn: deop 意为深，词尾 -th 把它变成一种度量。

items.en: Depths came to mean the deepest part of the sea.
items.cn: depths 开始指海洋最深的地方。

items.en: Writers used depth for the richness of a mind or a text.
items.cn: 作家用 depth 形容心思或文章的丰厚。

items.en: Painting and later photography spoke of depth in a picture.
items.cn: 绘画与后来的摄影开始谈画面里的纵深。

items.en: It now measures water, space, feeling and argument alike.
items.cn: 如今它同时衡量水、空间、感情与论证。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the deep family, and the meaning group moves from distance to richness of mind.
note.cn: 形近组属于 deep 这一家，近义组则从距离走到心思的丰厚。

entries.definition: going far down from the top
entries.definitionCN: 从顶部向下延伸很远的

entries.definition: to make or become deeper
very much, or far down
the space between two points
deep thought or great knowledge
entries.definitionCN: 深刻的思想或渊博的知识

entries.definition: the strength of a feeling

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a rope paid out over dark water and end with a book that asks to be read twice.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑暗水面上一点点放出的绳子开始，落到一本值得读两遍的书。

normal.en: Long becomes length, deep becomes depth: the same old ending.
normal.cn: long 变 length，deep 变 depth，用的是同一个古老词尾。

normal.en: A rope that keeps going is measuring depth.
normal.cn: 一直往下走的绳子，正在量深度。

normal.en: The depths are not a number but a place.
normal.cn: 深处不是一个数字，而是一个地方。

normal.en: A shallow pond and a shallow argument both show their bottom.
normal.cn: 浅塘与浅薄的论证，都让人一眼看到底。

normal.en: Depth of field keeps a photograph from looking flat.
normal.cn: 景深让照片不至于看起来是平的。

abstract.en: Picture a stone sinking until the line goes slack.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石头下沉，直到绳子松开。

abstract.en: Picture a diver looking up at a distant surface.
abstract.cn: 想象潜水员抬头看向遥远的水面。

abstract.en: Picture a page that seems to have more behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一页文字，背后似乎还藏着东西。

examples.en: The depth of the lake surprised the divers.
examples.cn: 湖的深度让潜水员吃惊。

examples.en: The fish live in the depths of the ocean.
examples.cn: 这种鱼生活在海洋深处。

examples.en: The book has a depth that rewards a second reading.
examples.cn: 这本书有一种值得再读一遍的深刻。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 depth 记成「deep 加 th」：deep 是深，th 是名词尾，像 long 变 length，depth 就是深度。

root: 来自古英语 deop（深）加名词词尾 -th，和 long 变 length 是同一条路。它先表示从上到下的距离，后来指最深的地方，再引申为思想与感情的深刻，也在摄影里表示画面的纵深。

sensesIntro.en: From a rope finding the bottom, to the bottom itself, to a mind with more behind it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从绳子触到底，到底部本身，再到背后还有东西的心思。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope keeps feeding out until a stone touches bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：绳子一直放，直到石头碰到湖底。

branches.en: The first sense is a distance measured downward.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是向下量出的一段距离。

branches.en: The second sense is the bottom as a place you can enter.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是可以进入的底部空间。

branches.en: The third sense is a mind or a text with room behind it.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是背后还有空间的心思或文字。

branches.en: A measurement and a location are only one letter apart.
branches.cn: 一种度量与一个地点，只差一个词尾。

branches.en: The sea and a story can both be sounded.
branches.cn: 海洋与故事，都可以测一测深浅。

intro.en: Depth sits in a small native family built on the Old English word for deep.
intro.cn: depth 位于一个小小本族词家族里，全部围绕古英语的「深」。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base here: depth is native English, formed with the old suffix -th.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词基：depth 是本族英语，用古老词尾 -th 构成。

items.example: The depth was over ten metres.
The deepness of the snow slowed us.
items.exampleCN: 积雪之深让我们走得很慢。
他们做了一项深入研究。

items.example: The depthless puddle dried at noon.
items.exampleCN: 那浅浅的水洼中午就干了。

items.meaning: the range that stays in focus
items.example: A small opening increases depth of field.

definition_en: to get something from a source, or to come from a particular origin
core_image: 一条小溪从岩缝里渗出，顺着山势往下越流越宽
scene: 老师带学生沿河往上游走，最后停在山脚一处小小的泉眼边。Many English words derive from Latin roots.
sceneCN: 这里 derive 指「源自」（第 2 个义项：从某个源头而来）；句意是许多英语单词源自拉丁词根。

senses.title: Get something from a source
senses.definition: to get something such as pleasure, income or knowledge from a particular source
senses.definitionCN: 从某一来源获得乐趣、收入或知识等
senses.example: She derives great pleasure from teaching children.
senses.exampleCN: 她从教孩子这件事上得到很大乐趣。
senses.why: The good thing is not made on the spot; it flows in from somewhere else.
senses.whyCN: 好处并非当场造出，而是从别处流进来的。

senses.title: Come from an origin
senses.definition: to come from or have its origin in something
senses.definitionCN: 从某事物而来，以其为起源
senses.example: Many English words derive from Latin roots.
senses.exampleCN: 许多英语单词源自拉丁词根。
senses.why: Every stream can be followed back to the spring that fed it.
senses.whyCN: 每条溪流都能顺水追到供它水的那眼泉。

senses.title: Reach by reasoning
senses.definition: to reach a result by reasoning from facts or rules already known
senses.definitionCN: 依据已知事实或规则推理得出结果
senses.example: We can derive the answer from these two simple rules.
senses.exampleCN: 我们可以从这两条简单规则推出答案。
senses.why: Reasoning is a channel cut from known ground to a new result.
senses.whyCN: 推理就是从已知的地面开一条渠，通向新的结果。

intro.en: Derive comes from Latin derivare, to lead water away from a stream, built on de- and rivus, a stream, and it reached English through French.
intro.cn: derive 来自拉丁语 derivare，本义是把水从河里引走，由 de- 与 rivus（小河）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Rivus named a stream, and derivare meant to lead its water into a new channel.
items.cn: rivus 指小河，derivare 指把河水引进新的渠道。

items.en: Writers extended it from water to words, arguing that one form flows from another.
items.cn: 作家把它从水移到语言上，说一个形式是从另一个形式流出来的。

items.en: French deriver carried the sense of coming from a source.
items.cn: 法语 deriver 带着「自某处而来」的意思。

items.en: English took it up for both obtaining something and tracing an origin.
items.cn: 英语用它同时表示获得某物与追溯来源。

items.en: Science added the mathematical sense of working a result out from rules.
items.cn: 科学又添上从规则算出结果的数学义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -rive sound, while the meaning group runs from starting somewhere to getting and inferring.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -rive 这一段音，近义组则从发源一路走到获得与推断。

entries.definition: to take something away from someone
a form or thing that comes from another
entries.definitionCN: 由另一形式或事物派生的东西

entries.definition: the origin or formation of a word
to begin to exist in a particular place
to get something that you want
to reach a conclusion by reasoning

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with water leaving a spring and end with a rule that yields an answer.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从水离开泉眼开始，落到一条算出答案的规则。

normal.en: A river and a word both have a spring somewhere upstream.
normal.cn: 河与词，上游都有一眼泉。

normal.en: To derive is to follow the water back, not to invent it.
normal.cn: derive 是顺着水往回找，而不是凭空造水。

normal.en: Pleasure, profit and meaning can all be led into your own field.
normal.cn: 乐趣、收益与意义，都能被引进你自己的田里。

normal.en: The Latin root rivus is a stream, and the word still flows.
normal.cn: 拉丁词基 rivus 是小河，这个词至今还在流。

normal.en: A formula is a channel dug from known facts to a new result.
normal.cn: 公式就是从已知事实挖向新结果的一条渠。

abstract.en: Picture a hand cupping water where it seeps from rock.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在岩缝渗水处捧起一汪水。

abstract.en: Picture a map where every small tributary points back to one dot.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，每条小支流都指向同一个点。

abstract.en: Picture a proof written line by line until the last line lands.
abstract.cn: 想象一份证明一行行写下去，直到最后一行落定。

examples.en: Many English words derive from Latin roots.
examples.cn: 许多英语单词源自拉丁词根。

examples.en: She derived great pleasure from teaching children.
examples.cn: 她从教孩子这件事上得到很大乐趣。

examples.en: The formula can be derived from two simple rules.
examples.cn: 这个公式可以由两条简单规则推导出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 derive 记成「得瑞武」：de 像「得」，rive 像「河」，从河里得到水，就是获得与源自。

root: 来自拉丁语 derivare，本义是把水从小河里引走，由 de-（离开）与 rivus（小河）组成，经法语 dériver 进入英语。后来从引水引申为获得好处，又引申为追溯来源与推理推导。

sensesIntro.en: From water led out of a stream, to a word traced to its root, to a result reached by rule.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把水从河里引出，到把一个词追到词根，再到按规则推出结果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stream led out of its old channel into a new one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一股水被引出旧河道，流进新渠道。

branches.en: The first sense is what the new channel brings you.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是新渠道带给你的东西。

branches.en: The second sense is the spring that every channel starts from.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是每条渠道起步的那眼泉。

branches.en: The third sense is a channel dug by reasoning alone.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是单靠推理挖出的渠道。

branches.en: Getting and coming from are the two ends of one flow.
branches.cn: 获得与源自，是同一条水流的上下游两端。

branches.en: A word traced to its root and a result traced to its rules use the same backward walk.
branches.cn: 词追到词根、结果追到规则，用的是同一种往回走的步子。

intro.en: Derive has a small Latin family built on a stream and on the act of leading water away.
intro.cn: derive 有一小族拉丁词，建在「小河」与「引水」这两件事上。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin rivus, a stream, and de- adds the sense of away or down.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词基是拉丁语 rivus（小河），前缀 de- 添上离开、向下的意思。

items.meaning: to lead or draw from a source
items.example: They derive support from old friends.
items.exampleCN: 他们从老朋友那里得到支持。

items.meaning: the act of tracing an origin
items.example: The derivation of the word is unclear.
items.exampleCN: 这个词的来历并不清楚。

items.example: Credit is a derivative of that Latin verb.
items.exampleCN: credit 是那个拉丁动词的派生词。

items.example: The result is derivable from the data.
items.exampleCN: 这个结果可以从数据推出。

items.example: The drug is derived from a common plant.
items.exampleCN: 这种药是从一种常见植物中提取的。

items.meaning: the act of getting from a source
items.example: He is deriving a new model.
items.exampleCN: 他正在推导一个新模型。

items.meaning: in a way that comes from something else

definition_en: to say what someone or something is like
core_image: 一个人用手指在空气里勾出轮廓，让旁人看见他脑中的形状
scene: 目击者在警局里回忆那个人的样子，从身高一直说到外套的颜色。She described the man carefully to the police.
sceneCN: 这里 describe 指「描述」（第 1 个义项：用语言说出某人某物的样子）；句意是她向警方仔细描述了那个人。

senses.title: Say what something is like
senses.definition: to say what someone or something is like by giving details
senses.definitionCN: 通过给出细节说出某人某物的样子
senses.example: She described the man carefully to the police.
senses.exampleCN: 她向警方仔细描述了那个人。
senses.why: The speaker lends his eyes to a listener who was not there.
senses.whyCN: 说的人把自己的眼睛借给一个不在场的听者。

senses.title: Call it by a name
senses.definition: to say that something is of a certain kind or quality
senses.definitionCN: 说某事物属于某种类型或具有某种性质
senses.example: He described the plan as a waste of money.
senses.exampleCN: 他把这个计划称作浪费钱。
senses.why: Once you have traced the shape, you can pin a label on it.
senses.whyCN: 轮廓描完之后，就可以在上面别一个标签。

senses.title: Trace a shape through space
senses.definition: to move along a path so that it forms a particular shape
senses.definitionCN: 沿某条路线移动，从而形成一个特定形状
senses.example: The needle described a clean arc on the paper.
senses.exampleCN: 指针在纸上画出一道干净的弧线。
senses.why: A moving thing can write its own outline without a hand.
senses.whyCN: 会动的东西不必用手，也能写下自己的轮廓。

intro.en: Describe comes straight from Latin describere, built on de-, down, and scribere, to write, so its oldest picture is an outline written down.
intro.cn: describe 直接来自拉丁语 describere，由 de-（向下）与 scribere（写）构成，最古老的画面就是被写下来的轮廓。

items.en: Scribere meant to write or scratch marks, and describere meant to copy out a shape.
items.cn: scribere 指书写或刻痕，describere 指把一个形状照样描下来。

items.en: Surveyors used it for marking out land on a map.
items.cn: 测量员用它来表示在地图上标出一块土地。

items.en: English borrowed it for setting down a scene in words.
items.cn: 英语借它来表示用文字把一个场景记下来。

items.en: It gained the weaker sense of calling something by a name.
items.cn: 它又添了一层较弱的用法：给某物安上一个名号。

items.en: Science kept the old geometric sense of a path traced in space.
items.cn: 科学保留了它古老的几何义：在空间里划出的一条路径。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the scribe element, while the meaning group all put a scene into words or pictures.
note.cn: 形近组共用 scribe 这一段，近义组则都把场景变成文字或画面。

entries.definition: words that tell what something is like
entries.definitionCN: 说明某物是什么样子的文字

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a finger drawing a shape in the air and end with a label pinned on it.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一根手指在空中画出形状开始，落到别在上面的一个标签。

normal.en: A description is a picture made of words instead of lines.
normal.cn: 一段描述就是用词而不是线条画出的图。

normal.en: If a listener can draw it, the describing worked.
normal.cn: 如果听的人能画出来，这段描述就成功了。

normal.en: De- plus scribere is writing something down from top to bottom.
normal.cn: de- 加 scribere，就是把东西从上到下写下来。

normal.en: To describe a plan as foolish is to hand it a label.
normal.cn: 把一个计划说成愚蠢，就是给它贴上一张标签。

normal.en: A needle can describe an arc with no hand at all.
normal.cn: 一根指针不用手，也能画出一道弧。

abstract.en: Picture a finger tracing a face in the empty air.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指在空里描出一张脸。

abstract.en: Picture a list so exact that two strangers pick the same coat.
abstract.cn: 想象一份清单精确到两个陌生人会挑中同一件外套。

abstract.en: Picture a museum label that is longer than the object.
abstract.cn: 想象一张比展品本身还长的博物馆标签。

examples.en: She described the man carefully to the police.
examples.cn: 她向警方仔细描述了那个人。

examples.en: The report describes how the money was spent.
examples.cn: 这份报告说明了钱是怎么花掉的。

examples.en: He described the plan as a waste of money.
examples.cn: 他把这个计划称作浪费钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 describe 记成「地斯快布」：de 向下，scribe 是写，把眼前的样子一笔笔写下来，就是描述。

root: 来自拉丁语 describere，由 de-（向下）与 scribere（写）组成。本义是一笔一笔写下来、描出轮廓，后来引申为用语言叙述与形容，也可表示把某物称作什么。

sensesIntro.en: From an outline written down, to a name attached to it, to a path traced by a moving thing.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被写下来的轮廓，到贴在轮廓上的名字，再到移动之物划出的轨迹。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand tracing an outline that others cannot see.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手描出别人看不见的轮廓。

chain: AN EYE TAKES IN A SHAPE

branches.en: The first sense is the outline handed over in words.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是用语言交出去的轮廓。

branches.en: The second sense is the label fixed at the end of the tracing.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是描完之后别上去的标签。

branches.en: The third sense lets the outline draw itself by moving.
branches.cn: 第三个义项让轮廓靠移动把自己画出来。

branches.en: Telling what a thing is like often ends in naming what it is.
branches.cn: 说清一个东西的样子，常常以说出它是什么收尾。

branches.en: Both senses leave a visible line behind, one in words, one in space.
branches.cn: 两个义项都留下看得见的线，一个在文字里，一个在空间里。

intro.en: Describe gathers words about writing an outline down, from a short account to something beyond words.
intro.cn: describe 聚起一族词，都与写下轮廓有关，从简短的叙述到无法用言语形容。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is scribere, to write, and de- adds the sense of writing something down in full.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 scribere（写），前缀 de- 添上「完整写下来」的意思。

items.exampleCN: 这种感觉几乎无法描述。
